pivot_line is initialized to point to the global md_dummy_blank_line constant.
Two stack buffers are used for line analysis; line alternates between them.
If line equals pivot_line, line switches to the other stack buffer to avoid overwriting pivot data.
Analyzes the current input line and fills the line struct with type, data, and offsets.
Checks if the line is a blockquote with no current block and admonitions enabled.
Iterates over the global MD_ADMONITION_TAGS array to find a matching admonition tag.

note: Vulnerable check: missing length validation allows md_ascii_case_eq to read past the line end when the line is shorter than the tag length.
Sets block->data to the matching tag index; if the tag match is incorrect due to the missing length check, block->data may be set to an unexpected value.
Returns early WITHOUT updating *p_pivot_line. This leaves pivot_line pointing to a stale line_buf entry or md_dummy_blank_line.
After the admonition early return, the next iteration may use the same line buffer as pivot_line, causing md_analyze_line to overwrite pivot data.
md_start_new_block is called with a line whose type field has been corrupted or points to an invalid location, causing a global-buffer-overflow READ 4 when reading line->type.
Reads 4 bytes from line->type. If line points to or past the end of the global md_dummy_blank_line, this is a global-buffer-overflow READ 4.
